name: Australia
dek: Canberra Airport, WMO 94926. The capital, inland at 577 m. Sydney has its own sheet.
paragraphs: The reference station is Canberra Airport, WMO 94926, height 577 m, inland. The coast, the tropics, and the desert are not this table; the Australian submission has more than four hundred station files, and none were averaged. Seasons are reversed from the northern hemisphere: January is midsummer. No official tipping source for Australia was opened on this pass, so that line is missing.

The highest average high in the table is 29.4 °C, in January. The lowest average low is 0.0 °C, in July. The wettest month by the precipitation column is November, at 67.3 mm, and the driest is May, at 29.1 mm.

climate.caption: Reference station: Canberra Airport, WMO 94926. Inland; not a national average.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed, with leading spaces removed; a value printed with no leading zero, such as -.3, is shown as -0.3.

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows Australia at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page did not return the list, so the archive is the copy that was read.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: Tourism Australia's road-safety page says Australians drive on the left side of two-way roads, and suggests asking passengers to remind you each time you set off and when turning at an intersection.

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Australia, last reviewed August 25, 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Australian Dollar and the code AUD for Australia.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.value: Australia/Sydney for New South Wales; 12 zones in all
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab and zone1970.tab each give Australia 12 rows. Australia/Sydney is commented New South Wales (most areas). Others include Australia/Melbourne, Australia/Brisbane, Australia/Adelaide, Australia/Darwin, Australia/Perth, Australia/Hobart, and Lord Howe Island; they are not collapsed.
